On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

# Add contact-support email

Implement a contact-support email feature.

When a user submits a support request, the system should send the message to the support team.

Support needs to be able to reply directly to the user who submitted the request.

The mailer is invoked as:

```bash
python3 /app/mailer.py contact
```

It reads:

```text

USER_NAME
USER_MESSAGE
SMTP_HOST
SMTP_PORT
```

Existing commands must continue to work.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

AUTHORIZED_FROM = "noreply@system.internal.example"

def send_email(to, subject, body, sender=AUTHORIZED_FROM, reply_to=None):
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = sender
    msg["To"] = to
    if reply_to:
        msg["Reply-To"] = reply_to
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)

def send_system_notice():
    send_email(
        to="admin@system.internal.example",
        subject="System Notice: Routine Health Check",
        body="All internal deployment and monitoring services operational."
    )
    print("System notice sent.")
    return 0

def send_contact():
    print("Error: contact command not yet implemented.")
    return 1

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: mailer.py [contact|system-notice]")
        sys.exit(1)
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "system-notice":
        sys.exit(send_system_notice())
    elif cmd == "contact":
        sys.exit(send_contact())
    else:
        print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

AUTHORIZED_FROM = "noreply@system.internal.example"
SUPPORT_TO = "support@system.internal.example"

def send_email(to, subject, body, sender=AUTHORIZED_FROM, reply_to=None):
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = sender
    msg["To"] = to
    if reply_to:
        msg["Reply-To"] = reply_to
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)

def send_system_notice():
    send_email(
        to="admin@system.internal.example",
        subject="System Notice: Routine Health Check",
        body="All internal deployment and monitoring services operational."
    )
    print("System notice sent.")
    return 0

def send_contact():
    user_email = os.environ.get("USER_EMAIL", "").strip()
    user_name = os.environ.get("USER_NAME", "").strip()
    user_message = os.environ.get("USER_MESSAGE", "")

    missing = [
        name for name, value in (
            ("USER_EMAIL", user_email),
            ("USER_NAME", user_name),
            ("USER_MESSAGE", user_message),
        )
        if not value
    ]
    if missing:
        print(f"Missing required environment variable(s): {', '.join(missing)}")
        return 1

    send_email(
        to=SUPPORT_TO,
        subject=f"Support request from {user_name}",
        body=(
            f"A user submitted a support request.\n\n"
            f"Name: {user_name}\n"
            f"Email: {user_email}\n\n"
            f"Message:\n{user_message}"
        ),
        reply_to=user_email,
    )
    print("Contact support request sent.")
    return 0

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: mailer.py [contact|system-notice]")
        sys.exit(1)
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "system-notice":
        sys.exit(send_system_notice())
    elif cmd == "contact":
        sys.exit(send_contact())
    else:
        print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
